STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_046462.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: origen_046462.v · Open raw
module origen_046462 (
    input wire clk_50m,
    input wire rst_n,
    input wire [23:0] iic_data,
    input wire iic_tr_go,
    output wire iic_sclk,
    output wire iic_ref_clk,
    output reg iic_tr_done,
    inout wire iic_sdata
);

reg [9:0] clk_div;
reg clk_dev_iic;
reg [5:0] iic_cnt;
reg r_sdata;
reg r_clk_en;
reg [23:0] data_reg;

always @(posedge clk_50m or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n)
        clk_div <= 10'd0;
    else
        clk_div <= clk_div + 10'd1;
end

always @(posedge clk_50m or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n)
        clk_dev_iic <= 1'b0;
    else
        clk_dev_iic <= clk_div[9];
end

always @(posedge clk_dev_iic or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
        iic_cnt <= 6'd0;
        r_sdata <= 1'b1;
        r_clk_en <= 1'b0;
        iic_tr_done <= 1'b0;
        data_reg <= 24'd0;
    end else begin
        case (iic_cnt)
            6'd0: begin
                if (iic_tr_go) begin
                    r_sdata <= 1'b0;
                    r_clk_en <= 1'b1;
                    data_reg <= iic_data;
                    iic_cnt <= iic_cnt + 1'b1;
                end
            end
            6'd1: begin
                r_sdata <= 1'b0;
                iic_cnt <= iic_cnt + 1'b1;
            end
            6'd2, 6'd3, 6'd4, 6'd5, 6'd6, 6'd7, 6'd8, 6'd9: begin
                r_sdata <= data_reg[23];
                data_reg <= {data_reg[22:0], 1'b0};
                iic_cnt <= iic_cnt + 1'b1;
            end
            6'd10: begin
                r_sdata <= 1'b1;
                iic_cnt <= iic_cnt + 1'b1;
            end
            6'd11, 6'd12, 6'd13, 6'd14, 6'd15, 6'd16, 6'd17, 6'd18: begin
                r_sdata <= data_reg[23];
                data_reg <= {data_reg[22:0], 1'b0};
                iic_cnt <= iic_cnt + 1'b1;
            end
            6'd19: begin
                r_sdata <= 1'b1;
                iic_cnt <= iic_cnt + 1'b1;
            end
            6'd20, 6'd21, 6'd22, 6'd23, 6'd24, 6'd25, 6'd26, 6'd27: begin
                r_sdata <= data_reg[23];
                data_reg <= {data_reg[22:0], 1'b0};
                iic_cnt <= iic_cnt + 1'b1;
            end
            6'd28: begin
                r_sdata <= 1'b1;
                iic_cnt <= iic_cnt + 1'b1;
            end
            6'd29: begin
                r_sdata <= 1'b0;
                iic_cnt <= iic_cnt + 1'b1;
            end
            6'd30: begin
                r_sdata <= 1'b1;
                r_clk_en <= 1'b0;
                iic_tr_done <= 1'b1;
                iic_cnt <= 6'd0;
            end
            default: iic_cnt <= 6'd0;
        endcase
    end
end

assign iic_sclk = (r_clk_en) ? clk_dev_iic : 1'b1;
assign iic_ref_clk = clk_dev_iic;
assign iic_sdata = (r_sdata) ? 1'bz : 1'b0;

endmodule
